argument_summary: Part 10 completes Appendix A by explaining PostgreSQL access and filter predicates, then comparing SQL Server and MySQL execution-plan terminology and operations.
PostgreSQL displays both access and index-filter predicates as Index Cond, while Filter is always a table-level filter predicate.
SQL Server distinguishes Seek Predicates from Predicates/where labels and presents graphical and tabular plan inspection.
MySQL uses access type, key_len, Using index condition and Using where to describe plan behavior before the book index and back matter.

previous_part_tail.translated_text: Hiệu quả của top-N query phụ thuộc vào execution mode của các operation bên dưới. Nó rất kém hiệu quả khi abort các nonpipelined operation như Sort.

WindowAgg
Cho biết đang dùng window function. Xem thêm “Using Window Functions for Pagination” ở page 156.

Caution
PostgreSQL không thể execute pipelined top-N query khi dùng window function.
